name: Arch-Semen
blurb: Fast and sneaky. DASH in (Q / ABILITY), THWACK, dash out.

name: Kallu Koli
blurb: Slow, long reach. WIDE SWING (Q / ABILITY): your next hit flattens everyone in front of you.

name: Mota-dalla
blurb: Slowest in the hostel. GAS (Q / ABILITY): a poisonous cloud that kills anyone who walks into it. Killers are immune.

name: Laal Jhanda
blurb: Throws his red cloth around your neck and pulls tight. No tricks, just fast and close.

name: Gujju Rapper
blurb: Lives in 303. Drops a beat, everyone freezes, then he sits on you until you stop moving.

name: Supreme Leader
blurb: Can't kill. Hold USE on a body for 3 s to bring them back (once per round). SHIELD (Q / ABILITY) protects you or the nearest player for 5 s.

name: Hosteller
blurb: Do your tasks. Don't die. Trust nobody.
